Assistant.description: Mode default depends on role. profile/result: candidate; need/matching/invitation: employer; conversation: either role. Matching/invitation require need + candidate; conversation requires invitation. Partial stage selection GET shows form; POST returns 400 before ownership resolution. Complete stage selection resolves ownership/visibility. For result identifier selects own finished attempt, else latest. For need identifier selects own Need, else last unless new_need=on; a new employer may start without Company/Need.

DraftApply.description: Actual stored Draft.mode selects the form. Profile applies description only; need creates a new own Need. Body cannot choose mode/owner/grade of Profile.

get.description:
Own tokens only. Processing consent is checked before confirmed/active account here. Create action validates name/kind/contact/draft scopes, stores digest, shows secret once in no-store/no-referrer HTML. MCP contacts rejected. Revoke requires own positive id. No automatic web action from token.
Repeat: Create issues another token; revoke remains revoked on repeat.
Read effects: No business write on GET/HEAD.
get.x-repeat: Create issues another token; revoke remains revoked on repeat.

403.description: Wrong role/unconfirmed email; POST additionally invalid CSRF.
